viewing_check: Read the ram's turquoise label (Sykes-Pickavant, tonnage, part no.) and look for SP stamps on the legs; screw the T-bar in to check the ram extends and holds pressure with no oil weeping; count the legs (twin and triple sets, short and long) and check for bent hooks.
